data.name: Misba
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root s-b-' which means to lead or guide. Misba is a name of a companion or guide in life. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Allah (swt) sends guides and helpers in the form of angels, prophets, and righteous individuals. Thus, Misba is a name that signifies one who is a guide or companion in life.

It reflects the belief that Allah (swt) sends messengers, angels, and righteous individuals as guides and helpers in human life.
